t: An honest diagnosis of what people choose
a: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
p: Bal tu'thirūna-l-ḥayāta-d-dunyā, wa-l-ākhiratu khayrun wa abqā.
m: But you prefer the worldly life, While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
